info.title: Knowledge graph L2: Core Data Element API
info.description: DAK component 5. CoreDataElement.fsh calls itself "the ONE EXCEPTION to allowing FHIR R4 models into the DAK LMs": `type` is one of valueset | codesystem | conceptmap | logicalmodel and `canonical 1..1 uri` points at it. The canonical is recorded; nothing inside it is copied, because FHIR is its own query layer. `name`, `resolutionStatus` and `extractionRule` are for elements recovered from DMN input expressions rather than declared in a dictionary. A recovered element is a name that was REFERENCED, not a definition that was found, and only a resolved one may carry a canonical. Class IRI: http://smart.who.int/kg/data-element.
